name: Decibel Cannabis Company Inc.
summary: Decibel Cannabis Company Inc., an integrated cannabis company, engages in the cannabis cultivation, processing, and sale of cannabis flower products in Canada. It is also involved in the extraction, processing, and manufacturing of cannabis derivative products, including vapes, cannabis infused pre-rolls, pre-rolls, edibles, and other value added products. The company also engages in the business-to-business cannabis product sales in the provinces of Saskatchewan and Alberta; and e-commerce end-user customers in the province of Saskatchewan.
